diagram_math_checks.check: Both affine height traces start at h_B. The ell trace ends at ell(D), strictly above h_D. The interior O has ell(O)=g_AC(O) because O is on AC, and the lower trace at O is g_BD(O). The arrow goes from g_AC(O) down to g_BD(O), representing delta=g_BD(O)-g_AC(O)<0.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Proof 2.1 establishes these equalities and strict order using 0<t<1 and A1. Def-lexicographic-lift-tie-break orders the common formal heights; the caption explicitly treats drawn vertical positions as order comparisons rather than evaluating epsilon.

diagram_math_checks.check: The difference is zero at the two boundary vertices of each overlay triangle and delta at O. Summing area times delta/3 yields area(ABCD)*delta/3<0.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Exactly proof 1.1 and 3.1; no new lemma or dependence on the picture is introduced.
